description: Secrets Manager Secret Policy Allows Any Principal
rationale: The resource policy has an Allow statement for Principal '*' (or uses NotPrincipal) without a condition that binds callers to an organization, account, source or VPC endpoint, so principals outside the account may be able to read the secret. An unreadable or malformed policy is UNKNOWN.
remediation: Restrict the policy to named principals or add aws:PrincipalOrgID / aws:PrincipalAccount / aws:SourceVpce conditions, and enable Block Public Policy validation (PutResourcePolicy BlockPublicPolicy).
